changes.comment: `dreamux uninstall` follows the existing next behavior: dry-run checks existence and reports planned removal without enumerating root contents or writing files; actual uninstall recursively removes the entire DREAMUX_ROOT, including other files and directories inside it. The foreign-retention predictor is removed. Results report removed or missing; permission and other filesystem errors still propagate, including after a successful preview. Normalized removal paths inside or containing a provider-derived operator runtime home are refused before any service mutation. Physical symlink aliases are not resolved. Current root addressing and service removal order remain unchanged.
